The numbers behind this report are in the CSV files of the same name: every step's tick figures and counts, and where the time went.
For what happens inside one block's or mob's tick, run /spark profiler during a run: these figures say where to look, spark says why in the code.
message.bsp_server_stress_test.cause.kin: It is a ticking block from %s: it does its work every tick, so its cost grows with how many there are and how much each one does.
Mobs think every tick: they choose what to do, look for paths and check what is around them, and crowds also push against each other.
It is an entity from %s that is updated every tick.
message.bsp_server_stress_test.cause.blo: Hoppers check every tick for items to pull in from above and to push out; long hopper chains and hoppers under item piles cost the most.
Spawners check every tick for a player in range and spawn mobs, which then cost ticks of their own.
Beacons check their pyramid and the sky above them and give their effects to the players around them.
Furnaces check their fuel and recipe every tick while they hold items.
Blast furnaces check their fuel and recipe every tick while they hold items.
Smokers check their fuel and recipe every tick while they hold items.
Sculk sensors listen for vibrations around them every tick.
Sculk sensors listen for vibrations around them every tick.
message.bsp_server_stress_test.cause.ent: Dropped items look every tick for other items nearby to merge with and check the ground under them; large piles cost the most.
Experience orbs look every tick for players to fly to and other orbs to merge with.
Villagers plan their day, look for beds, job sites and each other, and search long paths, which makes them some of the costliest mobs.
Lit TNT counts down every tick and explodes, and each explosion checks every block and entity around it.
Falling blocks are moved and checked for landing every tick.
Create contraptions move a whole structure of blocks every tick and check each of its blocks for collisions.
Create contraptions move a whole structure of blocks every tick and check each of its blocks for collisions.
Create contraptions move a whole structure of blocks every tick and check each of its blocks for collisions.
Create trains move every carriage's blocks every tick and check them for collisions along the track.
